title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
title_zh: SWIFT：通过目标外推实现自引导的弱到强扩散模型

paragraphs.en: 总结：Swift提出利用冻结的弱去噪器外推回归目标的自引导训练方法，可在不增加推理开销的情况下显著提升扩散模型质量。 Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. In this work, we introduce Swift, a simple yet effective self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser to improve a stronger model without adding inference overhead. For each noisy input, Swift extrapolates the clean regression target away from the weak denoiser's prediction, amplifying components that remain underfit. The weak guide can be an early training checkpoint, requires no backpropagation during main-model training, and is discarded afterward. The resulting model retains the original sampler and supports both conditional and unconditional generation without label dropout or an unconditional branch. We explain this mechanism through a spectral analysis of finite-time population gradient flow in an RKHS. With an early-stopped weak guide, we prove that a nonempty range of extrapolation strengths yields strictly lower posterior-mean error than matched standard training, despite shifting the regression target away from the posterior mean. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-256 demonstrate improvements across model scales and representations. In one ImageNet-256 configuration, Swift surpasses the baseline's best FID using roughly half the total training compute, including guide preparation and training overhead. On RAEv2, it achieves FID 1.15 without inference-time guidance and 0.99 with guidance. These results establish target extrapolation as an effective approach to weak-to-strong diffusion training with efficient single-model inference.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：Swift提出一种自引导训练方法，利用冻结的弱去噪器外推回归目标，可在不增加推理开销的情况下显著提升扩散模型质量。训练高质量扩散模型的计算开销很大，而推理时引导往往还会增加额外的采样成本。 在本工作中，我们提出Swift，一种简单而有效的自引导训练方法，它利用冻结的弱去噪器来改进更强的模型，且不增加推理开销。 对于每个含噪输入，Swift沿着偏离弱去噪器预测的方向外推干净的回归目标，从而放大那些仍未充分拟合的成分。 弱引导器可以是训练早期的一个检查点，在主模型训练期间无需反向传播，并且事后会被丢弃。 所得到的模型保留原始采样器，同时支持条件生成与无条件生成，无需标签丢弃，也无需无条件分支。 我们通过在RKHS中对有限时间总体梯度流进行谱分析来解释这一机制。 对于提前停止的弱引导器，我们证明存在一个非空的外推强度区间，使得后验均值误差严格低于同等的标准训练，尽管回归目标被推离了后验均值。 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-256上的实验表明，该方法在不同模型规模和表示方式下均带来改进。 在一个ImageNet-256配置中，Swift用大约一半的总训练计算量（包括引导器准备与训练开销）就超越了基线的最佳FID。 在RAEv2上，它在无推理时引导的情况下达到FID 1.15，在有引导的情况下达到0.99。 这些结果确立了目标外推作为一种有效方法，可实现从弱到强的扩散模型训练，同时保持高效的单模型推理。
